faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Pacifica?
faq.answer: Pacifica homeowners typically invest $6,000 to $13,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–15 windows. This dramatic coastal San Mateo County city combines older ranch homes with beachside properties where marine-grade performance is critical. Ocean-facing homes may see higher costs due to custom sizing and marine-grade specifications. Single window installation starts at approximately $560.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Pacifica?
faq.answer: Yes. Pacifica requires a building permit for window replacements. Coastal-zone properties may also require Coastal Development Permits from San Mateo County. Our team manages all permit and coastal compliance applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Pacifica?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Pacifica commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Pacifica?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Pacifica replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Pacifica?
faq.answer: Most Pacifica projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
